verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for an error-monitoring SaaS like Raygun, but the evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. It shows only alerts via email, Slack and Teams, plus Slack and PagerDuty integrations, and chat-app or incident-tool integrations do not qualify as webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
